acquisition.price: derived from recipe materials and existing margins

sources.supports: Prosopis alba density 760 kg/m3 at 15% moisture
Aeberhard et al. 2003: estimated algarrobo conductivity near 0.17 W/(m K), not a direct measurement
Nejeliski and Duarte 2019: gourd apparent density 124 kg/m3

limitations: Gourd conductivity and vegetable specific heat are author-approved design approximations. This simplified model does not simulate wall absorption. No historical specimen measurement is claimed. Fixed bronze straw is included in inventory mass and fabrication; its separate thermal exchange has not been calibrated.

CA_MATE_CONTENT.en: Water %.0f / %.0f mL | %.1f C | Yerba %d g | Uses %d / %d
CA_MATE_CONTENT.es: Agua %.0f / %.0f mL | %.1f C | Yerba %d g | Cebados %d / %d

CA_MATE_NO_SOURCE.en: Carry an unlocked bottle or canteen with potable water.
CA_MATE_NO_SOURCE.es: Lleva una botella o cantimplora con agua potable, sin reserva.

CA_MATE_NEEDS_YERBA.en: Fresh load: %d g yerba. Empty the water and discard the previous yerba first.
CA_MATE_NEEDS_YERBA.es: Carga nueva: %d g de yerba. Vacía el agua y descarta la yerba anterior.

CA_MATE_RULES.en: 60-85 C: hydration and resources. Below 60 C: hydration only. Above 85 C: wait for cooling.
CA_MATE_RULES.es: 60-85 C: hidratación y recursos. Menos de 60 C: solo hidratación. Más de 85 C: espera a que enfríe.

CA_MATE_REJECTED.en: Check water, yerba, temperature and carrying capacity.
CA_MATE_REJECTED.es: Revisa agua, yerba, temperatura y capacidad de carga.

CA_MATE_CONFIRM_DISCARD.en: Press again to discard this yerba load without recovery.
CA_MATE_CONFIRM_DISCARD.es: Pulsa otra vez para descartar esta carga de yerba sin recuperarla.

recovery: Ten real seconds using existing hydration pulses; each dose adds its own pending pulses without erasing earlier ones.
washed_out: Hydration only until yerba is discarded and replaced.
